seo.title: Analytics for Agencies, Manage All Client Sites in One Place
seo.description: OpenPanel helps agencies manage analytics for all client websites from one account. Privacy-first, no cookie banners, unlimited projects, and affordable per-client pricing from $2.50/mo.

hero.heading: Analytics for agencies
hero.subheading: Manage web and product analytics for every client from one account. No cookie banners to configure, no per-seat pricing, and one monthly bill based on events. From $2.50 a month, or self-host for free.

problem.title: Why analytics is painful for agencies
problem.intro: Managing analytics across dozens of client sites creates problems that most tools weren't designed to solve.

items.title: Google Analytics access management is a nightmare
items.description: Creating GA4 properties, managing user permissions, switching between accounts, and dealing with Google's constantly changing interface. Multiply this by 20+ clients and it's a full-time job.

items.title: Cookie consent for every single client
items.description: Every client site needs its own cookie consent banner configured correctly. Different jurisdictions, different requirements, different implementations, and one mistake can mean a GDPR fine.

items.title: Per-seat pricing kills agency margins
items.description: Most analytics tools charge per user. When your team of 10 needs access to analytics for client reporting, the cost adds up fast. Then the client wants access too.

items.title: No easy way to show clients their data
items.description: Clients want to see their analytics without logging into your tools. Exporting PDFs is tedious, sharing login credentials is insecure, and building custom dashboards takes time you don't have.

features.title: Analytics built for multi-client workflows
features.intro: OpenPanel works the way agencies do: multiple projects, multiple team members, one interface.

items.title: Unlimited projects per account
items.description: Add every client as a separate project under one account. No extra cost per project, just one monthly bill based on total event volume.

items.title: No per-seat pricing
items.description: Invite your entire team at no extra cost. Account managers, developers, strategists, everyone gets access. No reason to share logins or limit who can see data.

items.title: No cookie consent required
items.description: OpenPanel uses cookieless tracking by default. No consent banners to set up for any client, regardless of their location or audience. Saves hours of implementation per client.

items.title: Web analytics dashboard out of the box
items.description: Every project gets the overview on day one: visitors, sources, pages, devices, countries and campaigns. No report building before a client sees useful data.

items.title: Privacy compliance built in
items.description: Cookie-less tracking, data on Hetzner in Germany, and a GDPR data processing agreement included. Deploy analytics for clients in any market without a consent platform.

items.title: Web + product analytics combined
items.description: Pageviews, referrers and campaigns next to events, funnels, retention and user profiles. One tool instead of Google Analytics plus Mixpanel for clients who need more.

items.title: Quick setup for new clients
items.description: Add a script tag or install an SDK. Page views, outgoing links and data-track attributes are picked up automatically; custom events are one call each. Most client setups take under 15 minutes.

items.title: Self-hosting for full control
items.description: Agencies in sensitive industries can self-host OpenPanel with Docker Compose on their own servers. Free, unlimited events, releases a month or two behind Cloud.

items.title: Share links, export and API
items.description: Share an overview or dashboard with a client as a public link, with a password if you want. Pull data through the REST API, export events to S3 or GCS, or hand over the raw data.

items.title: One account for all clients

items.title: Ship cookie-free analytics for every client

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions from agencies evaluating OpenPanel.

items.question: How does pricing work with multiple client projects?
items.answer: You pay based on total event volume across all projects, not per project. For example, if you have 20 client sites generating a combined 100K events/month, you pay $20/month total. All projects share the same plan.

items.question: Can clients see their own analytics without a login?
items.answer: Two ways. Invite the client to their own project with read-only access; they see nothing else. Or share the overview or a dashboard as a public link, optionally behind a password, so they never need a login.

items.question: Do I need cookie consent banners for client sites?
items.answer: No. OpenPanel uses cookieless tracking by default, which doesn't require consent under GDPR, CCPA, or PECR. This eliminates one of the most common compliance headaches for agency deployments.

items.question: How do I set up tracking for a new client?
items.answer: Create a new project in your OpenPanel dashboard, copy the script tag, and add it to the client's website. Page views start tracking immediately. Custom events are one line of JavaScript each. Most setups take under 15 minutes.

items.question: Can I self-host for agency use?
items.answer: Yes. Self-hosting is free and has no project or event limits. One install script brings up Docker Compose with ClickHouse, Postgres and Redis. Self-hosted releases follow Cloud by a month or two.

items.question: How does OpenPanel compare to Google Analytics for agencies?
items.answer: OpenPanel is simpler to manage across multiple clients (one account, no Google permissions), privacy-compliant without cookies, and includes product analytics features that GA4 lacks. GA4 has more advanced attribution modeling and integrates with Google Ads. For most agency use cases, OpenPanel saves significant time on setup and compliance.

items.question: Is there an API for building custom reports?
items.answer: Yes. OpenPanel has a REST API for querying analytics data, managing projects and exporting events, plus S3 and GCS exports of the raw events and an MCP server your AI client can use. Build custom client dashboards or automate monthly reports from it.

items.question: Can I white-label the analytics dashboard?
items.answer: White-labelling is not a feature. Since OpenPanel is open source, agencies who self-host can change the dashboard's branding themselves. On Cloud, share links and the API are the way to put client data in your own reports.
